name: iso-prerender
description: A pre-rendering pipeline for 2:1 isometric games, plus Homestead 98 — a complete farm sim built with it. Bakes sprites offline into four AOV atlases (albedo/normal/material/stamp) and lights them in real time on the GPU; per-pixel depth is derived from the projection rather than baked, so occlusion is a hardware depth test. Zero runtime dependencies.
comment: devDependencies are for the offline QA tools only (headless screenshots, the end-to-end test, the timelapse GIF). `build`, `serve` and `single` use nothing but Node built-ins, and nothing in here is shipped to the browser.
